findings.titleDe: Feature 046 verwendet fuer alle 157 Kontrollen dieselbe generische Open-Bewertung ohne Einzel-Evidence.
findings.titleEn: Feature 046 uses the same generic Open assessment for all 157 controls without item-level evidence.
findings.residualRisk: The inventory is complete, but it cannot demonstrate that each control received substantive review.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: A control-level reassessment with direct or explicitly bounded evidence is performed.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: Konkrete technische Hinweise erscheinen nicht im kanonischen Observation-Register von Feature 046.
findings.titleEn: Concrete technical observations do not appear in Feature 046's canonical observation register.
findings.residualRisk: A zero-observation summary can hide known evidence limitations.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Canonical observations and PR evidence are reconciled.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: Feature 045 uebernimmt alle 157 Statuswerte aus Feature 016 mit tautologischer Aenderungserklaerung.
findings.titleEn: Feature 045 retains all 157 Feature 016 statuses with a tautological change explanation.
findings.residualRisk: The record does not independently prove the claimed reassessment depth.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: A sampled or complete control reassessment records claim-specific reasoning.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: Der manuelle Feature-046-Inhaltsreview weist null Sekunden Dauer aus.
findings.titleEn: The Feature 046 manual content review records an elapsed duration of zero seconds.
findings.residualRisk: The recorded trace does not prove that a human-readable semantic review occurred.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: A repeatable semantic trace records non-zero timestamps and reviewed hops.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleEn: The example smoke-test project has no Coverlet collector.
findings.residualRisk: Example coverage cannot be collected through the canonical collector path.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: The example project enters a coverage claim or the collector is intentionally added.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleEn: MSTest 4.3.2 remained unchanged despite documented 4.3.3 availability.
findings.residualRisk: The audit observed version drift but did not turn it into a canonical follow-up decision.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Dependency freshness is reassessed or the package version changes.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: Eine GitHub-Action verwendet weiterhin eine veraenderliche Referenz.
findings.titleEn: One GitHub Action still uses a mutable reference.
findings.residualRisk: A mutable action tag can resolve to different code without repository changes.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: The action is pinned to an immutable commit or explicitly accepted by an authorised owner.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: Node 26.7 lag ausserhalb der deklarierten LTS-Engine, ohne dass ein Produktfehler bewiesen wurde.
findings.titleEn: Node 26.7 was outside the declared LTS engine without proving a product defect.
findings.residualRisk: Validation on an unsupported host version may not represent supported CI environments.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: The supported engine range or validation host changes.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: Die drei Haupt-PRs besitzen keine eingereichte unabhaengige fachliche Review.
findings.titleEn: The three primary pull requests have no submitted independent substantive review.
findings.residualRisk: Green automation does not replace independent semantic review of audit conclusions.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: A future remote audit delivery records an independent submitted review.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.

findings.titleDe: 72 von 988 Feature-046-Referenzen sind am behaupteten Commit nicht hashgleich verifizierbar.
findings.titleEn: Seventy-two of 988 Feature 046 references cannot be hash-verified at the claimed commit.
findings.residualRisk: Evidence provenance cannot be reproduced for missing or mismatched claimed objects.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Every reference resolves at its claimed immutable commit with the recorded normalized hash.
findings.remediationBoundary: Feature 047 records the finding but does not remediate it or create follow-up work.
